events.name: Bridge Crossing

remembers.notice: At the near end, someone has nailed a new sign to the post. It points straight down. **THE HIDDEN VILLAGE · SOUVENIRS**

events.intro:
A gorge with no name on the map. A rope bridge, slung across a gorge so deep the river at the bottom is only a sound.

It creaks before you are even on it. The planks are grey with age, and every third one has been mended with something that was not meant to be a plank.

There is no other way across. The road behind you has already decided that for you.

success.text: You put one foot on the first plank. It takes your weight with a long, complaining groan, like an old man getting out of a chair.

effects.text: A plank goes. Then the rope. The river comes up fast. Dark. Then birdsong, and the smell of woodsmoke, and your lead licking your face.
It holds. The ropes are older than they look. Next time, perhaps not.

events.name: The Bridge: Youngster Ned
events.intro:
Five people stand along the bridge, spaced out like fence posts, each one waiting for you to reach them.

**Youngster Ned:** "Halfway won't do! You have to beat all five of us!"

success.text: The bridge bounces under both of you as the Pokémon come out. Nobody watching would call this a sensible place for a battle.

events.name: The Bridge: Camper Rosa
events.intro:
Number 2 of 5. The bridge sways under you, and the next one is already standing up to meet you.

**Camper Rosa:** "I've stood on this plank since breakfast. Don't look down. I did, once."

success.text: The bridge bounces under both of you as the Pokémon come out. Nobody watching would call this a sensible place for a battle.

events.name: The Bridge: Bug Catcher Wil
events.intro:
Number 3 of 5. The bridge sways under you, and the next one is already standing up to meet you.

**Bug Catcher Wil:** "The bridge sways when you lose. I've lost a lot. I'm used to it."

success.text: The bridge bounces under both of you as the Pokémon come out. Nobody watching would call this a sensible place for a battle.

events.name: The Bridge: Swimmer Jo
events.intro:
Number 4 of 5. The bridge sways under you, and the next one is already standing up to meet you.

**Swimmer Jo:** "If I fall in, I'll be fine. If you fall in... well. Let's battle."

success.text: The bridge bounces under both of you as the Pokémon come out. Nobody watching would call this a sensible place for a battle.

events.name: The Bridge: Ace Trainer Corin
events.intro:

**Ace Trainer Corin:** "Four down. I'm the one they keep for last. Show me why you got this far."

success.text: The bridge bounces under both of you as the Pokémon come out. Nobody watching would call this a sensible place for a battle.

events.name: The Far End
events.intro:
At the far end, a man in a plain coat is clapping. Slowly. He has been watching the whole way across.

**The man:** "Five for five. We pay well for that. Regular meals. A uniform. Interested?"

success.text: He shrugs, as if he had expected nothing else and is only a little sorry about it. He hands over the prize: a Nugget, heavy and cold. **The man:** "Offer stands."

effects.text: A man in a plain coat offered a uniform on the bridge. You said no.

success.text: He grins, too wide. **The man:** "Good. A small test first. Nothing you can't handle." His Pokémon is already out, and it is not really trying.

battle.name: The Man in the Plain Coat

win.text: You said yes to the man on the bridge. He wrote your name down.

success.text: He smiles, and taps the inside of his collar, where a single red letter is stitched. Then he waits, as if you should already know the answer.

events.name: The Far End
events.intro:
The letter on his collar is the colour of a warning sign. He sees you looking, and lets you look.

**The man:** "Well? It's a simple question."

success.text: He shrugs, as if he had expected nothing else and is only a little sorry about it. He hands over the prize: a Nugget, heavy and cold. **The man:** "Offer stands."

events.name: The Bank
events.intro:
You wake on a bank of round grey stones. The bridge is a thin line against the sky, very far up. Your bag is wet. Your lead is not leaving your side.

Something rustles in the reeds. Then something else. The gorge has noticed you.

success.text: You get up. Your knees are not sure about it. The reeds part.

events.name: The Narrows
events.intro:
The river runs through a slot in the rock here, fast and white and loud. There is no path along it. There is only across.

A Water-type could carry everyone over. A Flying-type could lift you. Otherwise, it is going to be cold.

success.text: It goes in without being asked, and takes you over one at a time, dry as a bone, and looks very pleased with itself on the far side.

choices.label: Let your Flying-type lift you over.

success.text: A few strong wingbeats, a moment of nothing under your feet, and then rock. Nobody gets wet. Nobody says anything about how high that was.
The water takes your breath straight out of you. You come out the far side shaking, and your lead is shaking worse. It will start its next battle a step slow.

events.name: The Old Path
events.intro:
Stone steps, worn into dips, and nobody has swept them for a very long time. Moss in every crack.

At the top of the first flight, a carved post. A leaf. And under the leaf, a hand, held up, palm out. Not *stop*, exactly. More like *wait*.

success.text: You climb. The steps go on a long way. Nothing stops you. At the top, the smell of woodsmoke.

events.name: The Mill
events.intro:
Smoke, first. Then a waterwheel, stopped, with river weed wound through its paddles. Then roofs: low, mossy, close together, like people keeping warm.

Nobody is surprised to see you. That is the strangest part.

success.text: A small boy sees you, and runs. A moment later an old woman comes out of the biggest house, drying her hands.

events.name: The Hidden Village

remembers.notice: There is a signpost at the edge of the village now, and a stall selling carved leaves. Granny Tamsel is not angry. She only looks tired. "We heard you talked," she says. "Well. Sit anyway."

events.intro:
A few houses, a mill, a pool that steams in the cool air. People who are not on any map, and would like to keep it that way.

**Granny Tamsel:** "You fell. Everyone who comes here fell. Sit. Eat. Then we'll see about a rope."

success.text: You sit. Somebody puts a bowl in your hands. It is hot, and plain, and the best thing you have eaten in weeks. Around you the village goes back to its day, and lets you be part of it.
You get up and walk. Nobody minds where you go.
There is always something that needs doing, in a place this small.
Granny Tamsel walks you to the foot of the cliff, where the rope hangs down.

events.name: The Hidden Village: Round the Houses
events.intro: A pool that steams. A little roofed shelf at the edge of the orchard. A fire, with an old woman beside it.

success.text: You follow the steam, down between the houses.
You walk out to the edge of the orchard.
You find a place by the fire.
You walk back to the middle of the village.

events.name: The Hidden Village: A Hand
events.intro: A stopped waterwheel. A small boy standing very still in the lane. A long table being laid under the trees.

success.text: You walk down to the stopped wheel.
A small boy is standing very still in the lane, looking at nothing.
Under the trees, they are laying the long table.
You walk back to the middle of the village.

events.name: The Healing Pool
events.intro:
A pool in a ring of flat stones, steaming. The water is the colour of weak tea and smells of moss. A child is sitting with her feet in it.

**Child:** "It fixes things. Not everything. Most things."

choices.label: Let your team rest in it.

success.text: One by one they wade in, and one by one their shoulders come down. When they climb out, every scrape is gone. The pool is a little cloudier. It will clear by morning.

events.name: The Berry Shrine
events.intro:
A little roofed shelf at the edge of the orchard, with a bowl on it. In the bowl, Berries. Next to the bowl, a carved hand, palm up.

There is no one watching it. There does not need to be.

choices.label: Take one for each of your team.

success.text: One each. You count twice, to be sure. The carved hand does not mind.

events.name: Granny Tamsel's Legend
events.intro:
In the evening, by the fire, Granny Tamsel tells the story the village always tells.

**Granny Tamsel:** "Nine little green ones, from nine far places. Each one fell, the way you did. Each one stayed."

**Granny Tamsel:** "They don't belong to us. We belong to them, a bit. One lives here now. It will look at you."

**Granny Tamsel:** "If it likes what it sees, it goes with you. We never give them. They go."

choices.label: Listen until the fire is low.

success.text: By the time she stops, half the village is asleep where they sit. You are not. You are thinking about being looked at.

events.name: Mend the Mill
events.intro:
The waterwheel has stopped. River weed has wound itself through the paddles, thick as rope, and the miller stands looking at it with his hands on his hips.

**The miller:** "Every spring. Every single spring."

choices.label: Send a Pokémon in to clear it.

success.text: Your Pokémon goes at the weed like it has a grudge. In a few minutes the wheel shudders, and turns, and the whole village looks up at the sound.
It takes the whole afternoon. Your hands are green to the wrist. When the wheel finally turns, the miller shakes one of them anyway.

events.name: Find the Hat
events.intro:
A small boy, Pip-Tamsel, has lost his straw hat. He is not crying. He is very nearly crying, and he would like you to know that he is not.

**Pip:** "It was my grandad's. It's too big. I was growing into it."

success.text: You look in the stream, on the mill roof, and under every bush he points at.

effects.text: It is in the stream, caught on a stone. You fish it out. Pip puts it on wet, and it comes down over his eyes, and he does not care.
It is on the mill roof. You climb. You do not look down. Pip claps when you hand it over.
It is on the head of a wild Lotad, sitting in the shallows, looking extremely pleased with itself.

events.name: The Lotad in the Hat
events.intro:
The Lotad wears the hat the way a king wears a crown. It has never owned anything before. You can tell.

Pip looks at the Lotad. The Lotad looks at Pip.

success.text: You hold out a Berry. The Lotad thinks about it for a long time, then tips its head, and the hat slides off into Pip's arms. It eats the Berry like it has won.

choices.label: Let it keep it; weave him a new one.

success.text: You sit with Pip by the water and weave reeds until your fingers ache. The new hat is lopsided. He loves it more than the old one, and will not say so.

events.name: Share Food
events.intro:
At dusk the village eats together, at one long table under the trees. Everybody brings something. Nobody checks.

**Granny Tamsel:** "Sit down, then. You're making the place look untidy."

success.text: You put a Berry in the big bowl in the middle. Somebody cuts it into enough pieces for everyone, somehow.
You cook. It is not very good. Everybody eats it anyway, and the miller asks for more, which is either kindness or a very strange palate.
You sit. You eat what you are given. You laugh when the others laugh. That, it turns out, was the task.

events.name: The Rope

remembers.notice: You are at the foot of the rope, ready to climb. Something is sitting on your bag. **Granny Tamsel:** "Well. It's decided, then. We don't give them. They go."

events.intro:
A rope, hanging all the way down from the broken bridge, knotted every arm's length. Somebody has tied it there for you.

**Granny Tamsel:** "One thing. You'll be asked where you've been. We'd take it kindly if you fell in a river, and that was all."

success.text: You climb. It takes a long time. When you look down from the top, the roofs are a few grey dots and the smoke is one thin line, and then the mist closes over them like a hand.

success.text: You let go of the rope. The village is still there behind you.

events.name: A Traveller with a Notebook
events.intro:
A traveller with a notebook stops you on the road. Pencil behind his ear. Mud to the knee.

**Traveller:** "You came up out of the gorge, didn't you? People talk about a village down there. Is it real?"

success.text: He looks at you for a moment, then writes something down and crosses it out. "No. Course not."
"Nothing at all?" "A river. Rocks." He sighs, and closes the notebook.
His whole face lights up. He writes and writes. You have the feeling, watching the pencil go, that you have just given something away.

events.name: Bulbasaur: The Hidden Garden
events.intro:
Behind the houses there is a garden where sick Pokémon come to rest. In the middle of it, a giant Venusaur lies wilting, its great flower drooping to the ground.

A Bulbasaur stands guard at its side. It does not take its eyes off you. Then it looks, pointedly, at the empty bucket by the well.

success.text: The walk from the well is short, and the bucket is heavy, and the path has a root in it exactly where you are not looking.

effects.text: You trip. Half of it goes on your boots. That one does not count.
You pour it at the Venusaur's roots. The soil drinks it at once.

events.name: Bulbasaur: The Thieves
events.intro:
The Venusaur lifts its head a little, for the first time. And then, at the garden wall, three shapes: Poison-types, slinking in after the healing herbs.

The Bulbasaur plants its feet in front of the Venusaur. It glances at you, just once.

success.text: You stand beside it. The thieves come anyway.

lose.text: The Bulbasaur watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Bulbasaur turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Chikorita: The Shadow
events.intro:
A Chikorita has followed you since you arrived. Everywhere. When your lead walks beside you, the Chikorita walks closer.

The village's dew bottle has gone missing. The Chikorita puts its nose to the ground, and finds the first clue at once: a drop of dew on a leaf, where no dew should be.

success.text: It goes pink from the leaf down. It does not look at your lead at all. It sets off along the trail at a trot.
Your lead looks pleased. The Chikorita sits down, very hard, and stares at nothing. It is not going to help now.

effects.text: The Chikorita watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Chikorita turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Chikorita: The Second Clue
events.intro:
The trail runs out at a fork. Left, the smell of mint. Right, the smell of woodsmoke. Ahead, river water.

The Chikorita looks at you, waiting.

success.text: Mint grows where the morning dew lies longest. The Chikorita nods, as if you passed something.
Smoke dries everything. The trail is gone. The Chikorita lies down in the path.

effects.text: The Chikorita watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Chikorita turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

success.text: The river smells of everything at once. You lose the trail in it.

effects.text: The Chikorita watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Chikorita turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Chikorita: The Third Clue
events.intro: In the mint, a bee, heavy and slow, flying the same line again and again. A broken cork, chewed. And a dent in the grass the size of a small, round body.

success.text: The bee goes home. The Chikorita sighs through its nose.

effects.text: The Chikorita watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Chikorita turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

choices.label: Follow the dent in the grass.

success.text: It leads to a Sentret, fast asleep, curled round the dew bottle like a pillow. The Chikorita carries the bottle home in its mouth, very proud, and walks right beside you all the way.
It is a cork. The Chikorita had already seen it. It waits for you to catch up, and you do not.

The Chikorita turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Treecko: The Dying Tree
events.intro:
A Treecko will not leave an old tree at the edge of the village. The tree is nearly gone: grey bark, three green leaves.

To speak to it, says the village, you must first beat the Treecko elder across the rooftops. The elder is already waiting on the first roof.

success.text: The elder flicks its tail: go.

events.name: Treecko: The Rooftops: First Gap
events.intro: The first gap. The roof on the far side is lower, and wet. The elder is already in the air.

success.text: You land, skid, keep going. The elder glances back, surprised.

failure.text: A beat late. The elder is already two roofs on. You will not catch it now.

effects.text: The Treecko watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Treecko turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Treecko: The Rooftops: The Long Roof
events.intro: A long roof, a loose tile halfway along, and the elder going straight over it without slowing.

success.text: Over it, and on. You lose a step. You keep your feet.

failure.text: The tile goes. So do you, very nearly. By the time you are up, the race is over.

effects.text: The Treecko watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Treecko turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Treecko: The Rooftops: The Last Leap
events.intro: The last roof, and the old tree beyond it. The elder is beside you, neck and neck.

success.text: The elder jumps first, too early, and has to scramble. You land clean. It looks at you a long time, then steps aside.

failure.text: Too early. You catch the edge, and hang there, and the elder looks down at you, not unkindly.

effects.text: The Treecko watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Treecko turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Treecko: The Old Tree
events.intro:
The Treecko sits in the last fork of the old tree, among the three green leaves. It lets you come close.

You can see, now, that it is not guarding the tree. It is keeping it company.

success.text: You cut a green shoot from the last living branch, and hold it out. The Treecko looks at it, and at the tree, and takes the cutting gently in its mouth. It comes down. It is coming with you.

choices.label: Tell it the tree will be fine.

success.text: It looks at you the way you would look at someone who says that. It goes back up into the leaves.

effects.text: The Treecko watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Treecko turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Turtwig: The Seedlings
events.intro:
A Turtwig carries the village's seedlings on its back, a little forest of them, all the way to the hill where they will be planted.

It lets you plant one. Then it settles down beside it, and looks at the sky, and waits for the weather.

success.text: You press the earth down round it. The Turtwig nods, slowly.

events.name: Turtwig: The First Weather: Sun
events.intro: The sun comes out hard. The sapling's leaves curl at the edges.

success.text: You water it. The Turtwig closes its eyes. Too much, too soon.

effects.text: The Turtwig watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Turtwig turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

success.text: Your arms ache. The Turtwig gently pushes them down.

effects.text: The Turtwig watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."

success.text: You wait. By evening the leaves uncurl on their own. The Turtwig shifts a little closer.

events.name: Turtwig: The Second Weather: Wind
events.intro: Wind, in the night. The sapling bends almost flat.

success.text: You tie it. The Turtwig unties it with its mouth, carefully, and looks at you.

effects.text: The Turtwig watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Turtwig turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

success.text: You wait. In the morning it is standing again, a little crooked, a little stronger.
The wall falls on it. The Turtwig does not say anything. It does not have to.

effects.text: The Turtwig watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Turtwig turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Turtwig: The Third Weather: Rain
events.intro: Rain, for a whole day. The ground goes soft. The sapling does nothing at all.

choices.label: Dig a ditch to drain it.

success.text: You cut its roots with the spade. The Turtwig walks away, very slowly.

effects.text: The Turtwig watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Turtwig turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

success.text: You wait. On the third morning, there is a new leaf. The Turtwig gets up, shakes the seedlings on its back, and walks to your side, as if that was always where it was going.

events.name: Snivy: Three Tests
events.intro:
A Snivy sits on the well wall as if it owns it. It looks you up and down and does not seem impressed.

The first test, plainly, is how you greet it.

success.text: It nods back, very slightly. Correct.
It looks at the hand. It turns its back for a beat. Then it turns round again, giving you one more chance.

The Snivy turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.intro: It hops down and walks. It expects you to walk too. The question is where.

success.text: Beside. It allows this.
It stops. It turns its back for a beat.

events.name: Snivy: Three Tests: When It Wins
events.intro: A wild Pokémon wanders too close. The Snivy deals with it in two moves, perfectly, and then looks at you.

success.text: You say nothing. The Snivy holds your gaze a moment longer, and then, for the first time, almost smiles. It walks at your side from then on.
It turns its back for a beat. Praise is for those who need it.

then.text: The Snivy watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Snivy turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Chespin: The Festival Food
events.intro:
The festival food is gone. All of it. A Chespin sits in the empty pot, round as a ball, licking its paws.

Somebody has to cook it again. The Chespin climbs out of the pot to help, which means tasting.

success.text: Six things on the table: Oran, Pecha, Rawst, Tamato, Chesto, and a pinch of salt. It likes three.

events.name: Chespin: First Ingredient
events.intro: The Chespin sniffs each one. Its ears go up at one of them.

success.text: Its ears stay up. In it goes.
It sneezes, hard. The pot goes over.

effects.text: The Chespin watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Chespin turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

success.text: It eats it, and falls asleep in the flour.

The Chespin turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Chespin: Second Ingredient
events.intro: It is reaching for the bowl. Again.

success.text: You move the bowl. It looks betrayed. Then it points, firmly, at the Pecha.
It tastes. And tastes. When you look again there is nothing left but the spoon.

The Chespin turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Chespin: The Last Two
events.intro: Pecha, then. And one more. The Chespin is leaning on your arm.

success.text: It tastes the finished pot (once, you allow it) and closes its eyes in bliss. At the festival, it sits on your knee the whole night.
It spits. The whole village hears it.

effects.text: The Chespin watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Chespin turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

success.text: Its quills go up all at once. Nobody eats that.

effects.text: The Chespin watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Chespin turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Rowlet: The Rescue
events.intro:
A Rowlet is stuck in a chimney. It is asleep. It has been asleep, the village thinks, for two days.

The chimney is on the far side of the village. To get there at night, you must pass three sleeping Pokémon without waking anyone.

success.text: The moon is thin. Everything is very quiet, and very close.

events.name: Rowlet: The Night Patrol: the Snorlax
events.intro: A Snorlax across the path, snoring like a bellows. The only way is round by the fence, between the posts, slowly.

success.text: Round by the fence, between the posts. It snores on.

failure.text: Your foot finds the one dry stick. Its eyes open. It sits up. So does every light in the village.

effects.text: The Rowlet watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Rowlet turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Rowlet: The Night Patrol: the Growlithe
events.intro: A Growlithe asleep on a step, one ear twitching. You are downwind. You only have to be slow.

success.text: The wind takes your smell away. The ear stops twitching.

failure.text: Too quick. It wakes, and barks, and barks.

effects.text: The Rowlet watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Rowlet turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Rowlet: The Night Patrol: the Hoothoot
events.intro: A Hoothoot on the chimney's own roof, eyes shut, one foot tucked up. Hoothoot never fully sleep. You wait for it to turn its head.

choices.label: Climb while its head is turned.

success.text: It turns its head, all the way round, the other way. You climb.

failure.text: You move a breath too soon. It hoots. Lights come on.

effects.text: The Rowlet watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Rowlet turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Rowlet: The Chimney
events.intro: You reach down into the chimney. Feathers. Warm. Still asleep.

success.text: You lift it out. It does not wake. You carry it home and put it on your bag, and go to sleep. In the morning it is on your head, awake, looking around as if it has always lived there.

events.name: Grookey: The Lost Stick
events.intro: A Grookey sits on a stump, drumming on its knees. It has lost its stick, and its rhythm with it. The beat keeps falling apart in its hands.

success.text: You bring the first stick. It holds it, taps it once, and throws it over its shoulder. Too light.

events.name: Grookey: Another Stick
events.intro: The second stick is better. It taps it twice. It throws it too. Too straight, somehow.

success.text: The third stick is crooked, and dark, and heavy at one end. It taps it. It taps it again. It grins.

events.name: Grookey: The Drum Pattern
events.intro: It plays a pattern on the stumps, and holds the stick out to you. *Long. Short. Short. Long.* Your turn.

success.text: You play it back. It plays it again, louder, faster, and the whole village starts clapping along. It finds the beat. It keeps it. It keeps you.

failure.text: Close. Not close enough. It stops. It looks at the stick. The beat falls apart again.

effects.text: The Grookey watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Grookey turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

events.name: Sprigatito: The Thief
events.intro: A Sprigatito strolls up, takes the Berry right out of your hand, and walks off with it. Not fast. It wants you to see.

success.text: You run. It runs. It is having the best day of its life.
You sit. You look at the trees. After a while there is a small weight in your lap: the Berry, a bit chewed. The Sprigatito sits down next to you, pretending it was always there.

events.name: Sprigatito: The Chase: the Orchard
events.intro: Through the orchard. It stops, looks back, and waits until you are nearly close enough.

success.text: Over the fence. It is laughing at you, somehow.
You sit, in the grass. You do not look. In a while it comes back by itself and drops the Berry in your lap, and sits, and leans on you.

events.name: Sprigatito: The Chase: the Mill Roof
events.intro: Up onto the mill roof. It sits on the ridge, Berry in its mouth, tail swishing, very pleased.

success.text: You catch it. It goes limp in your arms and lets you have the Berry. But it does not look at you again. Catching it was never the win.

effects.text: The Sprigatito watches you go. Granny Tamsel presses a Miracle Seed into your hand. "It'll let you try once more. Once."
The Sprigatito turns away for good. Some doors only open twice.

success.text: You sit down on the ground below, your back to the mill. A long while later there is a thump on the grass, and the Berry rolls against your hand. Then the Sprigatito climbs into your lap.

events.name: Nugget Bridge
events.intro:
The bridge north of Cerulean. A rope bridge, slung across a gorge so deep the river at the bottom is only a sound.

It creaks before you are even on it. The planks are grey with age, and every third one has been mended with something that was not meant to be a plank.

There is no other way across. The road behind you has already decided that for you.

success.text: You put one foot on the first plank. It takes your weight with a long, complaining groan, like an old man getting out of a chair.

effects.text: A plank goes. Then the rope. The river comes up fast. Dark. Then birdsong, and the smell of woodsmoke, and your lead licking your face.
It holds. The ropes are older than they look. Next time, perhaps not.

events.name: Cold Night's Rain
events.intro:
*Fade in. Rain.*

A road at dusk. A rock by the road. A small Fire-type on it, tail flame the size of a match, looking down the road at someone who isn't coming.

It looks at you. It looks back at the road.

success.text: You pick it up. It weighs almost nothing. Its tail hisses in the rain, and it does not fight you. It does not do anything at all.
You walk on. Behind you the rain keeps falling on the rock, on the little flame, on the road it is watching.

events.name: The Rock
events.intro:
It weighs almost nothing. Its tail hisses in the rain.

You open your coat and it climbs in without being asked, and turns round twice, and puts its head out under your chin to keep watching the road.

It will not battle. It will ride along. The rain will not stop tonight: Fire moves are weakened here, and Water moves are strong.

success.text: The road goes down towards the river. The rain does not let up.

events.name: The Culvert

remembers.notice: One of your team, one that was once left behind itself, comes and sits down beside it without being asked. Neither of them says anything.

events.intro:
A concrete pipe under the road, big enough to crawl into, dry at the back. A rest, of a kind.

The Fire-type watches the rain at the mouth of it. Its flame is very small.

success.text: You prop your coat on two sticks across the mouth of the pipe. The wind stops. The little flame stands up straighter.
*Offered food: it turns its head away. Its stomach is audible.*

choices.label: Let it sit outside; it's a Fire-type.

success.text: It sits outside in the rain, because you put it there. It does not complain. The flame gets smaller.

events.name: The Flooded Road
events.intro: The road is a river now, ankle-deep and running. Things live in it tonight that do not usually live on roads.

success.text: Something rises out of the water ahead.

events.intro:
A barn with half a roof. Dry straw at one end. You can hear the rain on the good half like gravel being poured.

The Fire-type climbs out of your coat and sits in the straw, and looks at you.

branches.text: *Offered again: it eats so fast it hiccups a spark.*

effects.text: It has gone very still. Your lead curls round it without being asked, and after a while the little flame comes back.

success.text: It turns its head away again. Its stomach is audible.

choices.label: Ask your Fire-type to sit with it.

success.text: Your Fire-type lies down in the straw and lets it lean on its warm side. After a while you can't tell whose flame is whose.

success.text: You sleep. When you wake it is in your coat again, as if it never left.

events.name: The Crossroads
events.intro: *A lantern, at the crossroads, swinging a little in the wind. Somebody is standing under it.*

success.text: The Fire-type goes very still in your coat.

events.name: The Crossroads: Damian

remembers.notice: **Damian:** "...It's you. From the Gym. Oh. Oh, this looks bad, doesn't it."

events.intro:
*A lantern. A trainer under a good umbrella.*

**Damian:** "Hey! That's— you found my— look, I was coming back. I was. I got busy. It's a long road."

*The Fire-type looks at him. Its flame doesn't change.*

branches.text: It climbs out of your coat and steps between you. It doesn't attack. It stands there, in the rain, flame up. Then you fight.

success.text: It hides inside your coat. You can feel it shaking against your ribs. You fight for it.

win.text: **Damian:** "...Take care of it. No. Don't tell me. I know you will. That's the whole point, isn't it."

success.text: It climbs out of your coat and steps between you, in the rain, flame up. You fight their team down to the last one. Then it steps forward.

events.name: Its Own Fight
events.intro:
Their last Pokémon comes out. Nobody sends the Fire-type out. It just goes.

It has one move. It is enough.

success.text: It stands in the rain with its flame up, and does not look back at you once.

effects.text: In the rain, it fought for itself.

events.name: It Warms to You
events.intro:
The rain is stopping. Not all at once: the way a person stops crying.

It climbs down out of your coat and sits in front of you, and looks up, and its flame is the biggest you have seen it.

success.text: It climbs back into your coat. It is not going anywhere.

effects.text: You saved a Fire-type from the rain, and it chose you.

events.name: A Small Scarf
events.intro:
At the Center, beside the nurse at the desk, a small Fire-type sits on the counter wearing a little knitted scarf. Healthy. Warm. Somebody else saved it.

*It looks at you for a moment. It doesn't look away quickly.*

success.text: Then the nurse calls the next name, and it turns to watch her instead.

events.name: Cold Night's Rain
events.intro:
*Fade in. Rain.*

The road out of Cerulean. A rock by the road. A small Fire-type on it, tail flame the size of a match, looking down the road at someone who isn't coming.

It looks at you. It looks back at the road.

success.text: You pick it up. It weighs almost nothing. Its tail hisses in the rain, and it does not fight you. It does not do anything at all.
You walk on. Behind you the rain keeps falling on the rock, on the little flame, on the road it is watching.

events.name: The Squirtle Squad
events.intro:
A small town on the road, with its shutters down in the middle of the afternoon.

Somebody has painted a turtle in sunglasses on the side of the fire station. Somebody else has tried to scrub it off, and given up halfway.

success.text: The street is very quiet. Too quiet, for a town with this much paint on it.
You keep to the road. Behind you, faintly, something that sounds a lot like a bucket hits the ground.

events.name: The Pranksters
events.intro:
A bucket falls on your head. It is full of water. Of course it is.

*Five Squirtle in pointed shades on a wall. The one in the middle folds its arms.*

That one is the Leader: a Wartortle, in fact, a head taller than the rest. It looks at you over the top of its shades. The others look at it.

choices.label: Shake the water off, and face them.

success.text: The Leader nods once, as if you have agreed to something.

events.name: The Standoff
events.intro:
Officer Jenny has already rounded up the Lesser members. They sit in a row on the kerb, shades off, sulking.

Only the Leader is left: a Wartortle, on the roof of the fire station, arms folded. It is not coming down.

**Officer Jenny:** "It won't come down for me. Maybe it'll come down for a trainer."

choices.label: Sit down with the Lesser members first.

success.text: You sit on the kerb. They shuffle along to make room, suspicious. Then one of them stands up, and Officer Jenny lets it.

events.name: The Squad: Fight 1
events.intro: One of them steps out in front of the others, pushes its shades up its nose, and points at you. A challenge. The others cheer.

success.text: *The Squad opens with the hose!* A jet of cold water hits your lead square in the face. It is slower for it.

events.name: Specs
events.intro:
One of them is patting its face, looking for its shades. They are on the back of its head.

The others are trying very hard not to laugh.

success.text: It reaches round, finds them, and goes very red. The others laugh after all. It does not look at you again.
You hand it a spare pair of sunglasses, and say nothing. It puts them on. Now it has two. It looks extremely cool. It knows.

events.name: The Squad: Fight 2
events.intro: Another one steps out. The others cheer exactly as loudly as last time.

success.text: *The Squad opens with the hose!* A jet of cold water hits your lead square in the face. It is slower for it.

events.name: Tank
events.intro:
The biggest one plants its elbow on an upturned crate and looks at you. An arm-wrestle. It is very sure it is the strongest.

It isn't.

choices.label: Lose, on purpose, with a straight face.

success.text: You strain. You grit your teeth. You lose. *(It flexes. It looks at the others. They're impressed. It looks at you, and, very slightly, nods.)*
You win, easily. It stares at its own arm as if it has betrayed it. Nobody says anything for a while.

events.name: The Squad: Fight 3
events.intro: Another one steps out. The others cheer exactly as loudly as last time.

success.text: *The Squad opens with the hose!* A jet of cold water hits your lead square in the face. It is slower for it.

events.name: Smoulder
events.intro:
One of them stands very close to the others. Closer than it needs to. When your team comes near, it edges behind the biggest one.

It is looking at one of your Pokémon in particular. The warm one.

choices.label: Keep your Fire-type back, without a word.

success.text: You move your Fire-type behind you, as if by accident. The little one lets out a breath it has been holding for a long time.

choices.label: Let your team go where they like.

success.text: Your team wanders where it likes. The little one spends the whole time behind the others, shaking, pretending it is not.

events.name: Star
events.intro:
One of them has climbed onto a crate. It clears its throat. It has a routine.

It is not ready. You can tell from the first spin.

success.text: You watch every second of it. You clap at the end. *(It bows too low and falls off the crate. It gets up as if that was the ending.)*
You look away at the wrong moment. When you look back it is sitting on the crate, very still, and the routine is over.

events.name: The Leader
events.intro:
The Leader comes down at last, and stands in front of you, and takes off its shades. It folds them. It puts them in its shell.

Then it raises its fists.

success.text: *The Squad opens with the hose!* A jet of cold water hits your lead square in the face. It is slower for it.

events.name: The Leader
events.intro: It picks itself up. It puts its shades back on. Then it stands to attention, very straight, and salutes you.

success.text: You salute back. It holds the salute a moment longer than you, as is proper. The whole Squad stands up a little straighter.
You wave. It lowers its hand slowly, as if you have said something in a language it does not speak.

events.name: Something Bigger
events.intro: The Squad parts. Something big is coming down the street, slowly, the ground shaking a little with each step.

success.text: *The Squad opens with the hose!* A jet of cold water hits your lead square in the face. It is slower for it.
*The Squad opens with the hose!* A jet of cold water hits your lead square in the face. It is slower for it.
It was only a delivery cart, and a very large Slowpoke pulling it. The Squad looks embarrassed on its behalf.

events.name: The Town's Fire
events.intro:
Smoke. A real fire, three streets over, going up into the sky in a thick grey rope.

*The Squad looks at the smoke. They look at the Leader. Smoulder's shaking.*

choices.label: You're the fire brigade, aren't you?

success.text: The Leader salutes. They put it out in a line, passing water hand to hand, as if they have always known how. One by one, the town opens its shutters.
Your Water-types do it. The Squad stands in the street and watches. They are quieter, after.
It goes, behind your leg, the whole way. And at the end, when there is one flame left, it steps out and puts it out itself.

events.name: One of the Squad
events.intro: Later, the Squad lines up in front of you. One of them steps forward and holds out its shades.

success.text: It slides on a second pair, grins, and falls in beside you.

effects.text: It is one of the Lesser members.
It is the Leader. The Squad salutes it as it goes.
A member of the Squirtle Squad joined you, in its shades.

events.name: The Leader's Shades
events.intro:
The road goes past a fire station with a turtle in sunglasses painted on its side. Your Squirtle stops dead.

On the roof, arms folded, the Leader. Your Squirtle looks at it, and then at you. It has caught up. It knows it has.

choices.label: Let it go and challenge it.

success.text: Your Squirtle walks out alone into the middle of the street, and pushes its shades up its nose.
Your Squirtle watches the roof until the road bends. Then it pushes its shades up its nose, and walks on.

events.name: The Squirtle Squad
events.intro:
A small town on the road, with its shutters down in the middle of the afternoon.

Somebody has painted a turtle in sunglasses on the side of the fire station. Somebody else has tried to scrub it off, and given up halfway.

success.text: The street is very quiet. Too quiet, for a town with this much paint on it.
You keep to the road. Behind you, faintly, something that sounds a lot like a bucket hits the ground.

events.name: Bill's Lighthouse
events.intro:
A lighthouse on a cape, far out past the last houses. Its lamp is not turning. It is blinking: a signal, out to sea.

Something out there is answering.

At night, the wild Pokémon of the coast come down to the shore and stand on the sand, all facing the water.

success.text: You wait for dark. The beacon is only visible at night, and even then only from the right places.
You leave the cape behind you. Out at sea, the blinking goes on without you.

events.name: The Search
events.intro:
The beacon is only visible at night, and only from the right places. There are signs, if you can read them.

Five signs. Three right readings will lead you there. A wrong one costs a long walk.

success.text: There it is: the lamp, on the point, blinking. You can see the path up to it now.
You look for the next sign.

choices.label: Walk back to the first sign.

success.text: Five signs, and not enough of them read right. The night is long. You walk back along the shore to where you started, and look again.

events.name: The Search: A Light on the Sea
events.intro: A light out on the sea, blinking. It looks like a ship. It looks like it is the beacon.

choices.label: Follow the gaps, not the flashes.

success.text: It is a reflection. The gaps between the flashes line up with something on land, further round the cape.
You go the wrong way, and you only know it after an hour of walking.

events.name: The Search: A Ship's Horn
events.intro: A ship's horn, out in the dark. Long, and low.

success.text: It is answering something behind you. You turn round, and there, faint on the headland, is a blink of light.
You go the wrong way, and you only know it after an hour of walking.

events.name: The Search: A Line of Wingull
events.intro: A line of Wingull, flying low over the water in a hurry, crying.

success.text: They are flying away from it. You walk the way they came, against the wind.
You go the wrong way, and you only know it after an hour of walking.

events.name: The Search: Krabby on the Rocks
events.intro: Krabby on the rocks, dozens of them, all facing one way. None of them moves when you pass.

success.text: You go the way they face. A few of them shuffle round to keep facing it as you pass.

choices.label: Go the way they turn their backs on.

success.text: You go the wrong way, and you only know it after an hour of walking.

events.name: The Search: The Tide
events.intro: The tide, going out. You can hear it pulling at the stones.

choices.label: Follow the tide's pull, to the point.

success.text: It is pulling toward the point. You follow it out across the wet sand.
You go the wrong way, and you only know it after an hour of walking.

events.name: The Long Way Round
events.intro: The wrong way is a long way. The shore goes on in the dark, and the beacon is no nearer.

success.text: It costs you the walk, and nothing else. You come back to the signs with sand in your shoes.

events.name: The Shore
events.intro:
*Thirty wild Pokémon on the sand, facing the sea. None of them looks round.*

*Under the surface, something passes. It takes a long time to finish passing.*

success.text: You stand with them. After a while your lead comes and stands beside you, and faces the sea too. It will not say why.

events.intro:

*A man and a Dragonite, forty years ago. A child on a Lapras. And some that shouldn't be here: Pokémon from regions you have already finished, in places you have been.*

events.intro:
Research logs, pinned up all the way round the spiral stairs. Three hands.

**The first hand, neat:** *"Signal sent 2100. No reply."*

**The second, hurried:** *"Reply at 2140. Not a ship. Not anything I've a name for."*

**The third, a child's, in crayon:** *"it says hello back. it is sad. i told it about my dog."*

events.name: The Lamp Room
events.intro:
The lamp room. A machine as big as a wardrobe, humming. And at the console, a Clefairy.

**The Clefairy, in a man's voice:** "Don't laugh. I'm Bill. There was a mishap. The red button. No, the other red button."

success.text:
You press the other red button. There is a flash, and a pop, and a man sitting on the floor where the Clefairy was, and a Clefairy sitting next to him, looking just as surprised.

**Bill:** "Thank you. I've been a Clefairy since Tuesday. The worst part is, I didn't mind it."

You laugh. You can't help it. The Clefairy folds its arms and waits until you have finished, then points at the button, and you press it.

**Bill:** "Thank you. I've been a Clefairy since Tuesday. The worst part is, I didn't mind it."

**Bill:** "Thank you. I've been a Clefairy since Tuesday. The worst part is, I didn't mind it."

events.name: Bill's Lighthouse
events.intro:
A lighthouse on a cape, far out past the last houses. Its lamp is not turning. It is blinking: a signal, out to sea.

The second trader does not look at your Pokémon at all. What comes back is stranger than the last one.
The third trader smiles. What comes back is not from this region, and nobody says where it is from.
"Suit yourself."

events.name: The Galley
events.intro: **Chef, Madame Brioche:** "Sit. You're thin."

success.text: She feeds your whole team, and you. A full meal: everyone is fully healed, and something on the plate stays with you.

effects.text: Spicy Curry: for your next battle.
Citrus Salad: for your next battle.
Hearty Stew: for your next battle.
Grilled Fish: for your next battle.
Sweet Dumplings: for your next battle.

success.text: You walk past. There will be other rooms.

events.name: The Secret Trade Room
events.intro:
Behind the kitchen, past the stoves, a door with no handle on the outside. Somebody has wedged it open with a ladle.

Inside: a card table, a lamp, and people who do not give their names.

success.text: Madame Brioche watches you go, and says nothing. "Traders. The odd kind. Don't tell the purser." For the rest of the voyage, there is a third trade at every cabin, each stranger than the last.
You leave the door as it is. Whatever is traded in there, it is not for you.

events.name: The Engine Room
events.intro:
Below the waterline, in the heat and the noise, a team is loading crates that aren't on the manifest.

One of the crates is breathing.

success.text: A caged Pokémon looks up at you. Two Grunts look up from the crates at the same moment.

lose.text: You wake on the harbour wall with your bag beside you. Nothing is missing. The passengers and their trades have sailed on. A steward has left a parcel: "From the captain. The Network Machine, and his compass."

success.text: Mr. Ashworth listens, goes pale, and sends two officers down. By the time they get there the crates are gone, and so is the team.
You walk away. The crate goes on breathing behind you.

events.name: The Stowaways
events.intro:
A barrel in the corner is humming "Prepare for trouble". The lid pops off: Jessie, James and a very flustered Meowth.

**Meowth:** "We are NOT stowaways. We are, uh. Barrel inspectors."

success.text: "Prepare for trouble!" "Make it double!" The barrel rolls away mid-motto.

lose.text: You wake on the harbour wall with your bag beside you. Nothing is missing. The passengers and their trades have sailed on. A steward has left a parcel: "From the captain. The Network Machine, and his compass."

success.text: You put the lid back on. The barrel says "thank you" in three voices.

events.name: The Seasick One
events.intro: A passenger's Pokémon, green about the gills, alone on a bench. Its trainer is nowhere to be seen.

success.text: You carry it up on deck. The wind does it good. When its trainer finds you, they shake your hand for a long time.
You sit with it until the worst passes. It leans on you. When its trainer finds you, they don't say anything; they just nod.
You walk past. There will be other rooms.

events.name: The Dining Room
events.intro: Pokémon eat at the tables in the dining room, napkins tucked in. Your team gets a table of its own.

choices.label: Sit one of them at the head of the table.

success.text: It sits at the head of the table, very straight, and is served first. It will not stop looking at you.
You walk past. There will be other rooms.

events.name: The Game Room
events.intro: Cards, under green lamps. The odds are printed on the felt, honestly: the house wins four hands in ten.

choices.label: Play a hand: ₽500 on the table, 60% to win ₽1,000.

success.text: You win the hand. The dealer slides the chips across without a word.

failure.text: You lose the hand. The odds were on the felt.

success.text: You watch a few hands, and keep your money.

events.name: The Beauty Contest
events.intro: A beauty contest in the ballroom. One entrant each. The judges look at condition, and at how much the Pokémon trusts its trainer.

success.text: A polite round of applause, and second place. The judges liked it, but they could tell: its condition, or how far it trusts you, was not quite there.

branches.text: It walks out like it owns the ballroom, in perfect condition, and looks back at you once, at the end. First place. The judges stand up.

success.text: You walk past. There will be other rooms.

events.name: The Collector
events.intro:
A man with a monocle and a velvet coat stops you on the stairs. He points at one of your team.

**Mr. Cornelius Quayle:** "That one. Name your price."

success.text: "Two thousand, then."
"Fifteen hundred. A pleasure." He takes it away with both hands, as if it might break.

events.name: The Collector
events.intro: **Quayle:** "Three thousand. I am being very reasonable."

success.text: "Five, then. Final offer. Probably."
"Three thousand. A pleasure."

events.name: The Collector
events.intro: **Quayle:** "Five thousand. You will not see an offer like it again on this sea."

success.text: He sighs, very deeply, and gives you his card. *Cornelius Quayle. Collector. Always buying.* "You'll hear from me."
"Five thousand. A pleasure, finally."

events.name: The Deck Cup
events.intro: The sun deck has been cleared for a tournament: three rounds, one winner, and a Rare Candy on a velvet cushion.

success.text: Three rounds, back to back.

lose.text: You wake on the harbour wall with your bag beside you. Nothing is missing. The passengers and their trades have sailed on. A steward has left a parcel: "From the captain. The Network Machine, and his compass."

success.text: You watch from the rail.

events.name: The Passenger Duel
events.intro: A passenger in a white suit flips a coin onto the table. "Two against two. The stake is a Premium Ball. Interested?"

success.text: Two against two, on the card table.

lose.text: You wake on the harbour wall with your bag beside you. Nothing is missing. The passengers and their trades have sailed on. A steward has left a parcel: "From the captain. The Network Machine, and his compass."

success.text: You decline. The coin goes back in the waistcoat pocket.

events.name: The Captain's Cabin
events.intro:
A cabin. A man the colour of old paper, lying very still in a bunk.

**Captain Winslow:** "Thirty years at sea. Still. Every voyage. Don't tell the crew."

success.text: You rub his back. After a while he breathes out, long and slow, and sits up.
Madame Brioche hands over the ginger without a word. The captain chews it, makes a face, and sits up.

choices.label: Let a Pokémon sing to him.

success.text: One of your team sings, quietly. The captain closes his eyes. When it finishes, he sits up.

events.name: The Top Deck

remembers.notice: **Rival:** "Front row for my next win. You're welcome."
**Rival:** "Twelve cabins, one captain, one top deck. I worked out you'd end up here before I boarded."
**Rival:** "Did you see the seasick one on the main deck? I hope somebody sat with it."

events.intro:
On the top deck, in the wind, someone you know is leaning on the rail.

**Rival:** "Of course you're on this boat."

success.text: A full battle on the top deck, the sea all round.

effects.text: **Rival:** "I'm ahead, you know. I counted on the way up the stairs."
**Rival:** "You're ahead. For now. Boats are good for catching up."
**Rival:** "Last time you beat me. I've thought about it every day since."
**Rival:** "Last time I beat you. Don't let the sea air fool you: I can do it again."
**Rival:** "And I saw you go down to the engine room. What was in those crates?"

lose.text: You wake on the harbour wall with your bag beside you. Nothing is missing. The passengers and their trades have sailed on. A steward has left a parcel: "From the captain. The Network Machine, and his compass."

events.name: The Captain's Gift
events.intro:
The captain is on his feet at the top of the gangway when the ship comes in. He presses two things into your hands.

**Captain Winslow:** "The Network Machine. And my compass. It has never once pointed north."

success.text: You go down the gangway with the Network Machine and the Captain's Compass. Behind you the S.S. Anne sounds its horn.

effects.text: You sailed on the S.S. Anne, and the captain gave you his compass.

events.name: A Familiar Face

remembers.notice: It is the owner of the seasick Pokémon. It is not green any more. It sees you first, and pulls its trainer across the road by the sleeve. **The owner:** "You! It remembers you. So do I."
Across the street, a velvet coat and a monocle. Mr. Quayle raises his hat to you, and then, unmistakably, looks at the same Pokémon as before. **Quayle:** "Still not for sale? I'm still asking."

events.intro: A face you know from the ship: someone from the dining room, or the card tables, or the rail. They wave. "The S.S. Anne! You were on her too!"

success.text: You talk about the voyage for a while, the way people do. The passengers got off at every port along this coast; you will see more of them.

events.name: The S.S. Anne
events.intro:
A great white liner at the harbour wall, flags up, the gangway down. The S.S. Anne, in port for one night.

A guard at the foot of the gangway checks every ticket twice. Nobody gets on without one.

choices.label: Hand over the Ticket and board.

success.text: "Welcome aboard!" The gangway creaks under your feet.

choices.label: Buy a spare Ticket at the harbour market (₽2,000), and board.

success.text: A stallholder sells you a spare ticket for ₽2,000, with a wink. The guard checks it twice, and lets you on.
You step back from the gangway. The ship sails at dawn without you.
